# Agentic harness (Anthropic)

Anthropic's "agentic harness" is the industry's [agent harness][industry.agent-harness]: "Claude Code is the harness; Claude is the model inside it" ([Claude Code glossary][a3]). Anthropic writes agentic harness where [Google][google.agent-harness] and [Microsoft][microsoft.agent-harness] write agent harness; the layer is the same.

## Examples

- Claude Code, the harness itself ([overview][a2]).
- The Claude Agent SDK, the same loop as a library ([Agent SDK overview][a4]).
- Managed Agents, "a hosted agent harness that runs the agent loop" ([Agent SDK overview][a4]).
